stanza: See the light of the afterworld
Shining on the ruins
It's the light of nowhere else
Burning to the west
See its sulphury shine
See its sulphury shine

ruins.line: Would you like to see the whole place in ruins
stanza: Would you like to see the whole place in ruins
Instead of all the things that they keep doing in our names?
Would you like to see the whole place a wreck
And then built back as something we all might respect?
Do you know what's worth fightin' for
When it's not worth dyin' for?
Does it take your breath away
And you feel yourself suffocatin'?
Does the pain weigh out the pride
And you look for a place to hide?
Did someone break your heart inside?
You're in ruins

ruins.line: Break free and leave us in ruins?
stanza: Break free and leave us in ruins?
Took this dagger in me and removed it
Gain the weight of you, then lose it
Believe me, I could do it
If it's all in my head, tell me now
Tell me I've got it wrong somehow
I know my love should be celebrated
But you tolerate it
There's a city, draped in net
Fisherman net
And in the half light, in the half light
It looks like every tower
Is covered in webs
Moving and glistening and rocking
Its babies in rhythm
As the spider of time is climbing
Over the ruins
Out of the ruins
Blood grown heavy from his past
His wings stripped by thunder
But those storms keep coming back
